question: Among all patients, how many individuals remain alive (i.e., with no recorded deceased.dateTime), have a diagnosis of either Diabetes or Hypertension, and are prescribed at least seven distinct active medications?
sql:
WITH alive_patients AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient`
  WHERE deceased IS NULL OR deceased.dateTime IS NULL
),
diagnosed_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    c.subject.patientId AS patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code IN ('44054006', '38341003')
),
med_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    mr.subject.patientId AS patient_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) AS distinct_meds
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY mr.subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) >= 7
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM alive_patients ap
JOIN diagnosed_patients dp ON ap.id = dp.patient_id
JOIN med_counts mc ON ap.id = mc.patient_id
